+import pytest
+
+from marshmallow import Schema, ValidationError, fields, pre_load, validates_schema
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("expand", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", ["load", "validate"])
+def test_item_validation_uses_processed_cardinality(expand, api):
+    seen = []
+    collections = []
+
+    class Record(Schema):
+        n = fields.Int()
+
+        @pre_load(pass_collection=True)
+        def reshape(self, data, **kwargs):
+            return data + data[:1] if expand else data[1:]
+
+        @validates_schema(pass_collection=True)
+        def check_collection(self, data, **kwargs):
+            collections.append([item["n"] for item in data])
+
+        @validates_schema
+        def check_item(self, data, **kwargs):
+            seen.append(data["n"])
+            if data["n"] == 2:
+                raise ValidationError("Rejected", field_name="n")
+
+    raw = [{"n": "1"}, {"n": "2"}]
+    expected = [1, 2, 1] if expand else [2]
+    error_index = 1 if expand else 0
+    messages = {error_index: {"n": ["Rejected"]}}
+    schema = Record()
+    if api == "load":
+        with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc:
+            schema.load(raw, many=True)
+        assert exc.value.messages == messages
+        assert exc.value.valid_data == [{"n": n} for n in expected]
+        assert exc.value.data is raw
+    else:
+        assert schema.validate(raw, many=True) == messages
+    assert seen == expected
+    assert collections == [expected]
+
+
+def test_original_pairing_still_requires_matching_lengths():
+    class Record(Schema):
+        n = fields.Int()
+
+        @pre_load(pass_collection=True)
+        def filter_records(self, data, **kwargs):
+            return data[1:]
+
+        @validates_schema(pass_original=True)
+        def check_original(self, data, original, **kwargs):
+            pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        Record().load([{"n": "1"}, {"n": "2"}], many=True)
